mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.image_url, p.created_at, (SELECT string_agg(c.slug, ',' ORDER BY c.sort_order) FROM photo_category pc JOIN category c ON c.id = pc.category_id WHERE pc.photo_id = p.id) AS category_slugs FROM photo p
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM photo_category pc JOIN category c ON c.id = pc.category_id WHERE pc.photo_id = p.id AND c.slug = #{slug})
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (owner_id, title, memo, image_url) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{imageUrl})
